# pangolin_role (Data Source)

Look up an existing role by org_id and either role_id or name. Exactly one of role_id or name must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pangolin_role" "example" {
  org_id = "acme"
  name   = "editors"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String)

### Optional

- `name` (String)
- `role_id` (Number)
